must_record: Every recipe line: the product made, the input, and how much of the input goes into one of the product
The version of the recipe each line belongs to
must_answer: What goes into this product, and how much of each input ends up in one finished unit?
must_prevent: A product that contains itself, however many steps away
A recipe read from lines belonging to two different versions
withdrawn_reason: Held by the CPG - Product Definition model, which owns what a product is, what it is made from and what it must be.

must_record: The same recipe lines, read from the input upwards
must_answer: Which finished products contain this ingredient, by any route?
withdrawn_reason: Held by the CPG - Product Definition model, which owns what a product is, what it is made from and what it must be.

must_record: Use of an input as a whole, never of what lies inside it
must_answer: Which products use this intermediate, and are any using a variant of it that should be its own product?
must_prevent: Adjusting what goes into an input from inside the product that uses it
withdrawn_reason: Held by the CPG - Product Definition model, which owns what a product is, what it is made from and what it must be.

must_record: The quantity the recipe called for, as it stood when the batch was made
The quantity each batch actually used
must_answer: How much more or less of each input did this batch use than the recipe specified?

must_record: Which input actually filled each place in the recipe on each batch, and whether it was the specified input or an alternative
must_answer: Which batches used an alternative input, and for which ingredient?
must_prevent: A batch that used an alternative input with nothing recording that it did

must_record: Each assessment of a supplier or outside manufacturer, its scope and how long it is valid
must_answer: Did this supplier hold a valid assessment on the day a delivery was received?
must_prevent: An assessment treated as current after it lapsed

must_record: What a supplier's document states about a batch, who issued it, and whether the organisation checked it
must_answer: Which of this batch's stated properties were tested here, and which were taken on the supplier's word?
must_prevent: A supplier's claim reported as though it were the organisation's own test

must_record: Which inputs are bought in finished, with contents the organisation does not know
must_answer: Which products depend on a bought-in ingredient whose contents we rely on the supplier to declare?

must_record: The allergens, other hazards, certifications and origin of each input, and which rules apply to each kind of product
must_answer: What allergens, hazards and certifications does this product carry, and from which inputs?
must_prevent: A product declared free of something one of its inputs contains
withdrawn_reason: Held by the CPG - Product Definition model, which owns what a product is, what it is made from and what it must be.

must_record: Each ingredient of a household product, how much of it there is, and whether it is withheld as confidential
must_answer: What must be disclosed for this household product, and what is withheld?
withdrawn_reason: Held by the CPG - Product Definition model, which owns what a product is, what it is made from and what it must be.

must_record: The use-by date of each batch, and the inputs that set it
must_answer: What is the latest date this finished batch can be used, given what went into it?
withdrawn_reason: Held by the CPG - Product Definition model, which owns what a product is, what it is made from and what it must be.

must_record: Every split and every combination of batches, with the quantities of each part
must_answer: Which batches came from this one, and which batches made up this combined one?
must_prevent: A split that produces a quantity with no batch it came from

must_record: How much of each item is held, in what condition, at which place, at what time
must_answer: How much of this material is available, on hold, or rejected at each site right now?
must_prevent: Stock on hold counted as available

must_record: Each size and pack as its own product, related to its family
Each change to a product, and whether it made a new product or a new version, and why
must_answer: Which pack sizes of this product exist, and did this change create a new product or a new version?
withdrawn_reason: Held by the CPG - Product Definition model, which owns what a product is, what it is made from and what it must be.

must_record: The versions of each recipe, when each took effect, and which version each batch was made to
must_answer: What recipe was this batch made to, and what was it meant to contain at the time?
withdrawn_reason: Held by the CPG - Product Definition model, which owns what a product is, what it is made from and what it must be.

must_record: Each individually identified unit, the product it is a unit of, and which unit or batch filled each part of it
must_answer: What exactly is inside this individual unit, and which batch did each part come from?
must_prevent: A batch built into a unit with no quantity recorded

must_record: The steps of each method in order, what each step needs, and its settings for each product on each line
must_answer: What steps, equipment, qualifications and settings does making this product need on this line?

must_record: The four levels of each recipe, and which level each came from
must_answer: Which instructions were issued for this batch, and which formulation did they come from?

must_record: The rules about what may run after what on each line, and why
Each changeover and each clean, with how long it took
must_answer: What ran on this line just before this batch, and was the line cleaned in between?
must_prevent: A product free of an allergen run straight after one containing it, with no clean between

must_record: Each place in the plant and what it sits within
Which machine stood in each place, from when to when
must_answer: Which machine was in this place on the day this batch was made?

must_record: Each machine's failures and how it failed, its repairs, its readings, and how much it matters
must_answer: Which machines cause the most unplanned stoppage, and how do they fail?

must_record: One record of each stoppage — start, end, and reason from a set list — with the lost output and the repair both tied to it
must_answer: How long did this line stop, why, and what did maintenance do about it?
must_prevent: One stoppage recorded twice
A stoppage with no reason

must_record: What each step of a batch was told to do, what it did, what resulted, who did it, and whether they were qualified at the time
must_answer: Who carried out each step of this batch, and were they qualified on that day?
must_prevent: Work by someone not qualified going unnoticed

must_record: Each movement of goods — from where, to where, when, how much, which batch
must_answer: Where has this batch been, and where is it now?

must_record: Each test with its method, sample, sampling plan and result, and the version of the specification it was judged against
must_answer: Did this batch meet the specification in force when it was made, and by what test?

must_record: Departures from procedure against the batch run, and failures against specification against the batch made — separately, each with how serious it is and how it was contained
must_answer: What went wrong on this batch — a procedure not followed, the product out of specification, or both?
must_prevent: The two being recorded as one

must_record: Each hold, the decision taken, the reason, and who decided it
must_answer: What was decided about this failed material, why, and by whom?
must_prevent: A decision with no named decider

must_record: For each corrective action: the cause, what was done, the check that it worked, and when it was closed
must_answer: Which corrective actions are open, and were any closed without checking they worked?
must_prevent: Closing an action before checking it worked

must_record: Each release — who released it, when, on what basis, and what it covered
must_answer: Who released this batch, when, and on what basis?
must_prevent: Stock treated as available because a batch finished

must_record: The lot code given at first packing or transformation, carried at every later movement, kept for two years
must_answer: Every batch this ingredient batch went into, and everywhere those went — within twenty-four hours
must_prevent: A movement recorded without its lot code

must_record: Each complaint, and the batch where the person can supply it
must_answer: Which complaints concern this batch, and what else was made from the same inputs?

must_record: Each signing — who, what, when, and what it meant — each second check, and each correction as a new entry
must_answer: Who signed this record, what did it mean, and has anything been corrected since?
must_prevent: An entry altered without a correction being recorded

must_record: Which party made or packed each batch, the specification they were given, and when the goods became the organisation's
must_answer: Which of our finished batches were made by an outside manufacturer, to which specification, and when did they become ours?

must_record: The conditions each place must keep, and any breach against the stock held there
must_answer: Was this batch ever stored outside its permitted conditions?

must_record: The identifiers each place and each machine carries, and who issued each
must_answer: Which place or machine is this, whatever identifier the supplier or regulator used?

must_record: The expected and actual cost of each product, by element
must_answer: What did this batch cost against its standard, and why?
withdrawn_reason: Cost is not held in this model (REQ070 is withdrawn).

must_record: Each level a product is packed in, such as unit, case and pallet
How many of the next level down each level holds
must_answer: How many units are in a case of this product, and how many cases on a pallet?
must_prevent: A level that holds nothing, or holds itself
